meta.title: km/h to m/s — Convert Kilometer/hour to Meter/second | Turbo
meta.description: Convert Kilometer/hour (km/h) to Meter/second (m/s) instantly. 1 km/h = 0.27777778 m/s. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert kilometer/hours (km/h) to meter/seconds (m/s) instantly. Both measure speed, so the relationship is strictly linear: each kilometer/hour equals 0.27777778 meter/seconds. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One kilometer/hour is equal to **0.27777778 meter/seconds**. To go the other way, one meter/second equals **3.6 kilometer/hours**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> meter/seconds = kilometer/hours × 0.27777778

Worked example — converting 10 kilometer/hours:

10 × 0.27777778 = **2.7777778 m/s**.

To invert, divide by 0.27777778 (or multiply by 3.6).

- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 km/h ≈ 0.27777778 m/s. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Kilometer/hour and Meter/second both measure speed; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many meter/seconds are in 1 kilometer/hour?
**A:** 0.27777778 meter/seconds.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert km/h to m/s?
**A:** meter/seconds = kilometer/hours × 0.27777778.

**Q:** How do I convert m/s back to km/h?
**A:** Multiply by 3.6 (or divide by 0.27777778).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this km/h to m/s converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
